- We can offer a conditional ladder: Net30 (months 1–2), Net45 (months 3–6), Net60 after 6 months if payments have been on-time and consumption > agreed threshold.

Hi Sonia,

Thanks for the clear asks — please find a compact proposal below (attached as two files for your records). High level:

1) Payment ladder (conditional) — summary
- Pilot (Months 1–2): Net30 payment terms
- Scale (Months 3–6): Net45 terms once pilot metrics (onboarding + usage) are met
- Steady state (Month 7+): Net60 eligibility once 6 consecutive on-time payments and usage > €25k/month OR a 3-month rolling average > €20k/month
- Security buffer: 20% deposit of month-1 committed spend due on contract execution. Deposit is applied to first invoice(s) and unlocks Net45/Net60 assessments.

2) Invoicing & AP notes
- Invoices will contain line items separated into Reserved Capacity and Usage. Please map them in your ERP to GL codes X123 (Reserved) and Y456 (Usage).
- Remit to: Redwood Inference EU — IBAN: DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 (our EU billing entity). If LedgerHealth requires local-entity invoicing, flag and we will coordinate with finance.

3) VAT handling (short)
- If LedgerHealth provides a valid EU VAT ID for the purchasing entity, Redwood will issue invoices net of VAT and LedgerHealth will apply reverse-charge where applicable.
- If no VAT ID is provided, Redwood will charge VAT according to the invoice country.
- Attached: VAT reverse-charge matrix (entity mapping + example invoice lines).

4) Operational cadence & approvals
- We can supply a signed one-page addendum for AP and legal that codifies the ladder and deposit terms.
- Proposed next step: Sonia to confirm remit entity and VAT IDs for the three EU entities by EOW; we will then send the addendum and an initial invoice for the 20% deposit.

Attachments: RWID_NETTERM_LADDER_v1.pdf; VAT-reverse-charge-matrix.xlsx

Let me know if you want this as a Salesforce Contract Amendment (we can push through quickly).

Thanks,
Monica Patel

Sonia — thanks for the questions, quick operational answers below and next steps.

1) Deposit: yes, ACH/Sepa to the EU IBAN is fine; deposit will be applied against the first invoice automatically and the invoice will show the deposit credit line. We will include the transaction reference on the invoice so your AP can reconcile.

2) Invoice splitting: we will create separate invoices per legal entity so Belgian invoices will include VAT and UK/DE invoices will be net where you provide valid VAT IDs. That is standard practice for cross-entity customers.

3) On-time definition for Net60 eligibility: an on-time payment is one where the payment clears (funds received in our account) within the nominal payment term window (Net30/45/60). For the Net60 unlock we require 6 consecutive invoice cycles with funds received within the term window; any late payment breaks the streak and resets the assessment period. We can add a one-time grace exception at our discretion for extenuating circumstances.

Next steps:
- Monica: please send the sample split invoice (PDF) and the short addendum (1 page) so we can route to Sonia's AP and legal.
- Sonia: when you have VAT IDs and remit entity confirmations, send them to hannah@redwood.com and ap@redwood.com.

I'll draft a short note for the contract amendment once we have the VAT IDs.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Revenue Operations
